power_headroom_criterion: Max modeled external load power at supply maximum, -5% load resistance and zero series resistance must be <=90% of the declared 2.5W load ceiling
minimum_current_criterion: Minimum modeled current at 4.75V, +5% load resistance and 0.15ohm series resistance must be >=0.34A
scientific_scope: Digital-only engineering tradeoff. 5% load variation, 4.75V lower bus, 0-0.15ohm series range and 10% margin are trial assumptions, not measured device/source specifications. No physically procured 13ohm load.
decision_policy: Find the highest minimum-current viable standard-candidate design under the power and current criteria; if no candidates are feasible, block. Source and native validation are necessary, not sufficient for physical release.
